CORPORATE PROFILE
Юẚㅎϸ


Chow Tai Fook Jewellery Group Limited (the “Group”; SEHK stock code: 1929) was listed on the Main
Board of The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong in December 2011. The Group’s vision is to become the
most trusted jewellery group in the world.

Founded in 1929, the Group’s iconic brand “CHOW TAI FOOK” is widely recognised for its
trustworthiness and authenticity, and is renowned for its product design, quality and value. A long-
standing commitment to innovation and craftsmanship has contributed to the Group’s success, along
with that of its iconic retail brand, and has been embodied in its rich 90 year heritage. Underpinning this
TVDDFTTBSFPVSMPOHIFMEDPSFWBMVFTPGi4JODFSJUZt&UFSOJUZw

The Group’s multi-brand strategy comprises the CHOW TAI FOOK core brand with its offerings of
different retail experiences including ARTRIUM, JEWELRIA, Experience Shop and CTF WATCH,
in addition to other brands including HEARTS ON FIRE, T MARK, ENZO, SOINLOVE and MONOLOGUE
to address the diversifying needs of our customers.

The Group’s commitment to sustainable growth is anchored in its customer-centric focus and strategies,
which are in place to promote long term innovation in the business, in people and in culture. Another
asset underpinning sustainable growth is a sophisticated and agile business model. This supports the
Group by fostering excellence and extending opportunities along the entire value chain to communities
and industry partners across the world.

With an extensive retail network in Greater China, Japan, Korea, Southeast Asia and the United States,
and a fast-growing e-commerce business, the Group is implementing effective online-to-offline (“O2O”)
strategies to succeed in today’s omni-channel retail environment.


周大福珠寶集團有限公司（「集團」；香港聯交所股份代號：1929）於 2011 年 12 月在香港聯合交易所主板上市，
以成為全球最值得信賴的珠寶集團為願景。

集團標誌性品牌「周大福」創立於 1929 年，廣獲認同為信譽及正貨的象徵，並以產品設計、品質與價值聞名。
集團及其標誌性品牌的成功，從過去 90 多年的悠久歷史，體現出對創新和工藝的持久堅持，以及恒久抱持的
核心價值「真誠 t 永恒」。

周大福實踐多品牌發展策略，以周大福核心品牌為主軸，相繼推出多元化的零售體驗，包括周大福藝堂、
周大福薈館、體驗店和周大福鐘錶，以及 HEARTS ON FIRE、T MARK、ENZO、SOINLOVE 與 MONOLOGUE
等其他品牌，以迎合顧客需要之多樣化。

集團借助以客為本的重點及其策略為基礎，實踐業務可持續增長的承諾，致力於業務、員工和文化方面推動
長遠的創新發展。發展成熟的靈活業務模式是推動集團可持續增長的一大優勢，在整個價值鏈中支持集團追
求卓越，以及延伸商機至不同社區和全球的行業合作夥伴。

集團擁有龐大的零售網絡，遍及大中華、日本、韓國、東南亞與美國，並經營發展迅速的電子商務業務，能有
效地執行線上線下策略，在現今的全渠道零售環境下成功突圍而出。

72   Management Discussion and Analysis
     管理層討論與分析
                                                                                                                                             Chow Tai Fook Jewellery Group Limited
                                                                                                                                                         周大福珠寶集團有限公司
• The Group’s daily operation was mainly financed by operating           • 本集團日常業務所需資金主要來自經營現金流量，
   cash flows, and mainly relied on short-term borrowings to satisfy      亦會主要以短期借貸滿足旺季時的存貨資金需求、
   inventory financing needs during peak seasons, working capital         未來擴展計劃所需營運資金及預計之外的需求。本
   for future expansion plans and unexpected needs. The Group has         集團於償還貸款方面並無任何困難。
   not experienced any difficulties in repaying its borrowings.

• The Group’s income and expenditure were mostly denominated             • 本集團之收入及開支主要以港元及人民幣計值，而
   in HKD and RMB, while its assets and liabilities were mostly           資產及負債則主要以港元、人民幣及美元計值。由
   denominated in HKD, RMB and USD. No hedging instrument is              於我們中國內地日常業務營運的收支大多以人民幣
   deployed against RMB fluctuation as most of the daily receipts         結算，對我們的業務並無構成重大的貨幣風險，因
   and payments for our Mainland operations are both made in              而未有針對人民幣波動動用任何對沖工具。
   RMB, which do not pose a substantive currency exposure to
   our business.
• It is our treasury policy to maintain high liquidity in response to    • 我們的庫務政策旨在保持較高的流動資金，以應付
   the requirement of operating cash flows; and to upkeep financial       營運現金流量的需求；同時緊守審慎的財務政策，
   prudence by not engaging in highly leveraged or speculative            避免涉及高槓桿或投機性衍生產品。
   derivative products.


Effect of RMB fluctuation                                                人民幣波動的影響
• As part of our business operation was in Mainland China, the           • 由於我們有部分業務在中國內地經營，人民幣的波
   fluctuation in RMB would post some impact on our performance.          動對我們的表現構成若干影響。

• Transactions entered by the Hong Kong entities but                     • 香港公司以人民幣計值的交易（包括與中國內地附
   denominated in RMB, including the inter-group transactions             屬公司進行的集團間交易）會按交易當天的現貨匯
   with the Mainland China subsidiaries, are converted into HKD,          率兌換為港元，即本集團的功能貨幣，而未結算的
   the functional currency of the Group, initially using the spot rate    交易則會以收市匯率於結算日換算。現貨匯率與收
   at the date of transaction and the unsettled transactions are          市匯率的匯兌收益或虧損於損益賬中確認，而人民
   retranslated at closing exchange rate at the balance sheet date.       幣貶值會對我們的年內溢利構成負面影響。
   Such translation differences between the spot rate and closing
   exchange rate are recognised in profit or loss, negatively
   affecting our profit for the year when RMB depreciated.

• Exchange difference also arises when i) incomes and expenses           • 此外，匯兌差異源於 i）中國內地分部的收支按平均
   of the Mainland China segment are translated into HKD, the             匯率換算為港元，即本集團呈列貨幣，而相應的資
   presentation currency of the Group, at the average exchange            產及負債按收市匯率換算；及 ii）中國內地分部的資
   rate, while the corresponding assets and liabilities are translated    產淨值於本財政年度的收市匯率較上個財政年度的
   at closing exchange rate and ii) change in closing exchange            收市匯率有所變動。有關差異於權益中的換算儲備
   rates at the current financial year of the net assets of the           內確認入賬。
   Mainland China segment from the closing rates at the previous
   financial year. Such differences are recognised in the translation
   reserve in equity.

Risk Management Process                                                   ䷕䯗ノ⤳≮⼸
GRMC is responsible for leading the risk management process in an         集團風險管理委員會負責按照《企業風險管理手冊》以
integrated approach in accordance with the Enterprise Risk                綜合方式指導風險管理流程。這管理委員會的成員為
Management Policy Manual. GRMC is a management committee                  董事總經理、四名執行董事，以及主要業務及功能單
comprises the Managing Director, four executive directors and             位的高級行政人員，涵蓋範疇包括法律、人力資本、
senior executives from major business and functional units, covering      投資者關係及資訊科技。我們的風險管理流程包括以
legal, human capital, investor relations and information technology.      下步驟：
Our risk management process involves the following steps:


• Identification – adopts both top-down and bottom-up approach.           • 識別 — 同時採納由上而下以及由下而上的方式。


• Analysis – assesses the potential consequences and likelihood           • 分析 — 評核風險發生的可能性以及潛在後果。
   of the risks.


• Evaluation – evaluates the risk level, risk treatment and priorities.   • 評價 — 評價風險水平、風險處理方法及優先次序。


• Mitigation – recognises the control gaps, assigns risk ownership        • 應對 — 識別監控差距、委派風險承擔人及確認風
   and confirms risk control measures.                                     險監控措施。


• Monitoring – conducts evaluations on the design and progress            • 監察 — 評價風險監控措施的設計以及實施進度。
   of implementation of the risk control measures.


• Reporting – facilitates risk communications, reviews the residual       • 報告 — 促進風險溝通，檢討監控措施後的剩餘風
   risk level after control measures and assesses areas for                險水平以及評核需持續改進的範圍。
   continuous improvement.

Internal Control                                                        ‫ڔ‬䘕Ⱀᣔ
The structure of our internal control system is based on the            我 們 的 內 部 監 控 系 統 架 構 是 以 Committee of
Committee of Sponsoring Organisations of the Treadway                   Sponsoring Organisations of the Treadway
Commission (“COSO”) integrated framework for effective internal         Commission（「COSO」）的 綜 合 框 架 為 基 礎，以 達 致
controls, which comprises 17 principles under five components,          有效的內部監控，該綜合框架由五個部份分 17 項原則
namely, Control Environment, Risk Assessment, Control Activities,       組成，五個部份為控制環境、風險評估、控制活動、
Information and Communication and Monitoring Activities.                訊息與溝通及監控活動。


Our internal control system is integrated into our business             內部監控系統已併入我們的業務流程，並有資訊系統
processes with the support of information system and technology.        及技術作支援。監控目的、授權及責任以行之有效的
Control objectives, authorities and responsibilities, backed by         政策及程序為後盾，而監控活動的表現會保存於系統內。
established policies and procedures, and the performance of
control activities are maintained in the system.


Our review of internal controls is closely linked with our risk         我們對內部監控的檢討工作與風險管理框架及流程息
management framework and process. Principal risks and risk              息相關。集團的主要風險和風險管理策略會傳達至業
management strategy of the Group are communicated to heads of           務及功能單位各主管以及內部審核團隊。此舉旨在協
business and functional units and internal audit team. This aims at     助他們進行資源及內控監督工作的分配。在管理層持
helping them to allocate their resources and control monitoring         續評價高風險範圍的監控工作之同時，內部審核團隊
efforts. Controls of high risk areas are continually evaluated by       將考慮是否根據集團重大風險而調整關鍵監控的審核
management while internal audit team would consider the need of         計劃。
adjustments on its audit plan on the testing of key controls for
significant risks of the Group.


On an annual basis, members of GRMC, senior management of all           集團風險管理委員會成員、各主要業務及功能單位的
major business and functional units are required to assess the          高級管理人員須每年以自我評價問卷方式，評核內部
effective implementation of internal controls through self-             監控措施的實行成效，內容涵蓋風險管理及內部監控

       Anti-Money Laundering (“AML”) regulations                                反洗錢法規
       Precious metals and stones, particularly gold and diamond, are           貴 金 屬 及 寶 石（尤 其 是 黃 金 及 鑽 石）因 其 內 在 價 值
       perceived to be exposed to higher risk of money laundering due to        高、重量低及容易攜帶，被視為面臨較高的洗錢風

       measures regarding customer due diligence, record keeping and            報。不符合監管要求會增加我們非故意協助洗錢活
       suspicious transaction reporting. Non-compliance with the regulatory     動的風險，因而構成罪行，最終可造成巨額財務損
       requirements increases the risk of which we could unintentionally        失，並且損害我們的聲譽。
       facilitate money laundering activities and may constitute an offence,
       resulting in substantial financial loss and damage to our reputation.


       We control and mitigate the risks by:                                    我們監控及緩和這些風險的方法如下：

          laundering exposure, review the effectiveness of our AML                 們反洗錢措施的成效，以及提升我們反洗錢的管
          measures and enhance our AML governance framework.                       治框架。

          oversee the implementation of internal AML policies, procedures          及監控之實施。
          and controls.

       • Offering (i) ongoing trainings for general staff to establish and      • (i) 向一般員工提供持續培訓，令他們對反洗錢事
          maintain their vigilance in AML matters; and (ii) regular refresher      宜 提 高 警 覺； 及 (ii) 向 洗 錢 匯 報 主 任 定 期 提 供
          trainings to MLROs to keep them abreast of AML regulatory                更新培訓，讓他們掌握最新的反洗錢監管要求或

Crisis Management                                                       ࢞ᾌノ⤳
By their nature, most of the crises are unpredictable, but we           危機在本質上是無法預測的，但我們相信可以判斷出
believe it is possible to determine activities and areas that may be    那些活動和領域特別容易陷入危機。我們認為針對該
particularly prone to crises. We believe advance planning for these     等領域作預先規劃實為關鍵所在，因為可以確保我們
areas is key to ensure our resilience against crises, reduce the        有面對危機的抗逆力、減低不利事件對我們的影響、
impact of adverse events, aid recovery and support business             有助復原並且支持業務持續發展。下文載列我們防範
continuity. Set out below are our pre-crisis measures that help us      於未然的措施，協助我們作好準備以應對危機：
maintain an appropriate level of preparedness to respond to crises:


Crisis Management Team                                                  危機管理團隊
We have assembled a Crisis Management Team with set roles for           我們已成立危機管理團隊，每位成員承擔特定的職務，
every members to ensure swift and coordinated response to               以確保迅速共同應對危機。我們的核心團隊由執行董
crises. Our core team is typically led by executive directors and       事率領，其他成員包括來自行政、法律、投資者關係
staffed with senior executives from executive office, legal, investor   及人力資本的高級行政人員。需要時亦會物色和招攬
relations, and human capital. Other personnel from varying              其他專業範疇和地區的人員加入。靈活的團隊組合方
disciplines and regions would be identified and staffed on an as-       式有助我們進行全面的漏洞評估，並有效恰當地應對
needed basis. This flexibility facilitates us to have an all-round      任何性質的事故。團隊的主要職能包括識別需要關注
vulnerability assessment and respond effectively and appropriately      的範圍、評估關注範圍的影響，以及制定策略和應對
to incidents of any nature. Principal functions of the team include     計劃以處理危機。我們會在需要時檢討和修訂團隊的
identifying the areas of concern, assessing the impact of the           組成、職務和責任，以確保團隊的效率和成效。
identified concerns and devising strategies and response plans to
overcome crises. The composition, roles and responsibilities of the
team will be reviewed and revised as necessary in order to assure
its efficiency and effectiveness.


Crisis Management Manual                                                危機管理手冊
The Crisis Management Manual enables us to identify,                    危機管理手冊有助我們適時識別、通報、提升及處理
communicate, escalate and address crises in the timeliest manner.       危機。手冊載列危機及觸發事件的定義、危機分類、
The Manual sets out the definition of a crisis and trigger events,      啟動指引、危機管理團隊的結構及職務以及危機通報
categorisation of crises, the activation guideline, the composition     和匯報規程。鑒於營商環境變化多端，危機會變得更
and roles of the Crisis Management Team and the crisis                  為複雜，我們會定期審閱手冊，確保更新手冊內容，
communication and reporting protocol. In view of the complexity of      所有修改或更新均會提交集團風險管理委員會會議討
crises caused by the evolving business environment, we will             論和檢討。手冊會按預定的時間表發放予有關員工，
perform regular review on the manual to ensure our manual is up-        特別於更換團隊人員及計劃有重大修改之後。
to-date. Any revisions to the manual will be tabled to GRMC
meeting for discussion and review. The manual will be
disseminated to relevant staff on a scheduled basis, especially
after any changes in team personnel and major revisions to plans.

Share Option Scheme                                                                                       䈩㗎‷㼵ް
A share option scheme (the “Scheme”) was adopted pursuant to a                                            本公司根據於 2011 年 11 月 17 日的一份股東書面決議
shareholders’ written resolution of the Company passed on 17                                              採納了購股權計劃（「該計劃」）。自該計劃採納日期至
November 2011. No options have been granted, exercised or                                                 本年報日期，本公司概無授出、行使或註銷該計劃下
cancelled under the Scheme since its adoption up to the date of                                           任何購股權。
this annual report.

             2.3 Principles of consolidation and equity                                      2.3 合併及權益會計原則
                 accounting
             (a)    Subsidiaries                                                             (a)   附屬公司
                    Subsidiaries are all entities (including structured                            附屬公司為本集團擁有控制權的所有實體
                    entities) over which the Group has control.                                    （包括架構性實體）。


                    The Group controls an entity when the Group:                                   本集團於下列情況下控制一家實體：


                    • has power over the entity;                                                   • 對實體有控制權；


                    • is exposed, or has rights, to variable returns from its                      • 對因參與該實體而承受或享有浮動回報
                       involvement with the entity; and                                              的風險或權益；及


                    • has the ability to affect those returns through its                          • 有能力透過其對該實體的權力影響其回報。
                       power to direct the activities of the entity.


                    The Group reassesses whether or not it controls an                             倘事實及情況反映上文所列三項控制因素
                    entity if facts and circumstances indicate that there are                      其中一項或多項改變，則本集團會重估是
                    changes to one or more of the three elements of                                否仍然控制實體。
                    control listed above.


                    When the Group has less than a majority of the voting                          倘本集團於實體之投票權未能佔大多數，
                    rights of an entity, it has power over the entity when                         而投票權足以賦予本集團實際能力以單方
                    the voting rights are sufficient to give it the practical ability              面指示實體的相關活動時，即對實體擁有
                    to direct the relevant activities of the entity unilaterally. The              權力。本集團於評估本集團於實體的投票
                    Group considers all relevant facts and circumstances in                        權是否足以賦予其權力時考慮所有相關事
                    assessing whether or not the Group’s voting rights in                          實及情況，包括：
                    an entity are sufficient to give it power, including:


                    • the size of the Group’s holding of voting rights                             • 與其他投票權持有人所持投票權的數量
                       relative to the size and dispersion of holdings of the                        及分散情況相對於本集團持有投票權的
                       other vote holders;                                                           數量；


                    • potential voting rights held by the Group, other vote                        • 本集團、其他投票權持有人或其他人士
                       holders or other parties;                                                     持有之潛在投票權；


                    • rights arising from other contractual arrangements; and                      • 其他合約安排產生的權利；及


                    • any additional facts and circumstances that indicate                         • 於需要作出決定之時，顯示本集團目前
                       that the Group has, or does not have, the current                             能夠或不能指示相關活動的任何額外事
                       ability to direct the relevant activities at the time                         實及情況（包括於過往股東會議上的投
                       that decisions need to be made, including voting                              票模式）。
                       patterns at previous shareholders’ meetings.


                    Subsidiaries are fully consolidated from the date on                           附屬公司在控制權轉移至本集團當日開始
                    which control is transferred to the Group. They are                            全面合併入賬。附屬公司在控制權終止日
                    deconsolidated from the date that control ceases.                              起從合併賬內剔除。

      (c)    Equity method                                                     (c)   權益會計法
             Under the equity method of accounting, the                              根據權益會計法，投資初始以成本確認，
             investments are initially recognised at cost and                        後續調整於損益確認本集團享有被投資公
             adjusted thereafter to recognise the Group’s share of                   司在收購後的損益份額，本集團應佔被投
             the post-acquisition profits or losses of the investee in               資公司之其他全面收益變動則於其他全面

             other comprehensive income of the investee in other                     確認為投資賬面價值的抵減。
             comprehensive income. Dividends received or

             The Group mainly leases various retail stores, offices              本集團主要租賃多項零售店、辦公室及倉

             that are held by the lessor. Leased assets may not be

      32. Capital Risk Management                                              32. 䇴᱙䷕䯗ノ⤳
             The Group manages its capital to ensure that the group              本集團管理資本旨在確保集團實體可持續經營，
             entities will be able to continue as a going concern while          並透過維持債務與權益的最佳平衡而為股東提供
             maximising the return to shareholders through the                   最大回報。
             optimisation of the debt and equity balance.


             The capital structure of the Group consists of bank                 本集團的資本架構包括銀行貸款、黃金借貸和本
             borrowings, gold loans and equity attributable to                   公司股東應佔股權（包括綜合財務報表所披露之
             shareholders of the Company, comprising share capital,              股本、儲備及保留溢利）。
             reserves and retained profits as disclosed in the consolidated
             financial statements.


             The management of the Group reviews the capital structure           本集團管理層定期檢討資本架構。本集團會考慮
             regularly. The Group considers the cost of capital and the          資本成本及各類資本相關的風險，亦透過派付股
             risks associated with each class of capital, and will balance       息、發行新股、籌集銀行貸款及黃金借貸平衡本
             its overall capital structure through the payment of dividends,     集團整體資本架構。
             new share issues as well as the raising of bank borrowings
             and gold loans.
